academyexample.skill.pulse.desc: A shock around you. Pushes back only what the server lets you hurt.
academyexample.skill.glide.desc: While on, you fall slowly. Costs CP every tick.
academyexample.skill.spark_step.desc: A short teleport forward, up to four blocks.
academyexample.skill.burst.desc: An explosion set off by a Kinetic Charge, attributed to the player who placed it.
